parameters.question: Preprocessing of raw mass spectrometry data (feature/peak extraction and RT alignment using BSA1_F1 as reference); output is the aligned feature table for BSA1. TSV with header (rt, mz, intensity, charge, quality) sorted by rt. Feature count must match the reference; each feature must match within rt +/-10 s, mz +/-0.01, and intensity within 10% relative absolute error.

Feature count must match the reference; each feature must match within rt +/-10 s, mz +/-0.01, and intensity within 10% relative absolute error. Rows sorted by rt; small rt/mz shifts may change ordering.
